title: The Future of Advice: In Conversation with GrECo Group CEO Georg Winter - Vantel
summary: Vantel turns complex insurance documents into structured intelligence, helping brokerages understand coverage, reduce risk, and make better decisions faster.
body_markdown:
Clients want somebody who can challenge them, keep them honest, and help them reach the best outcome. When a wrong decision could seriously affect the business, people still want a person on the other side of the table.


My thanks to Georg and the GrECo team for the conversation. The full discussion, including the risks of losing critical thinking and how leaders should respond when AI conflicts with their instincts, is worth the four minutes:[The Future of Advice (Full Discussion)](https://greco.services/the-future-of-advice/)
